note: Spider 1.0 dev, stratified sample by official hardness: 300 of 1034 proportional within each level, random.Random(2026). id is the question's index in dev.json. Built by experiments/build_spider_eval.py.

questions.question: Count the number of poker players.
What are the earnings of poker players, ordered descending by value?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Earnings FROM poker_player ORDER BY Earnings DESC

questions.question: List the final tables made and the best finishes of poker players.
Return the money rank of the player with the greatest earnings.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Money_Rank FROM poker_player ORDER BY Earnings DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Give the names of poker players who have earnings above 300000.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM people AS T1 JOIN poker_player AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID WHERE T2.Earnings  >  300000

questions.question: List the names of poker players ordered by the final tables made in ascending order.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM people AS T1 JOIN poker_player AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID ORDER BY T2.Final_Table_Made

questions.question: What is the average earnings of poker players with height higher than 200?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(T2.Earnings) FROM people AS T1 JOIN poker_player AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID WHERE T1.Height  >  200

questions.question: What is the most common nationality of people?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Nationality FROM people GROUP BY Nationality ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Return the nationalities for which there are two or more people.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Nationality FROM people GROUP BY Nationality HAVING COUNT(*)  >=  2

questions.question: List the names and birth dates of people in ascending alphabetical order of name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name ,  Birth_Date FROM people ORDER BY Name ASC

questions.question: What are the names of people who are not from Russia?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM people WHERE Nationality != "Russia"
